payload.summary: Filed test-suite-load-flakiness: five DIFFERENT tests each flaked exactly once under full-suite parallel load during the Phase 4 build (sweep-lock pre-seed, prototype start --variants 60s timeout, two tests/store/journal timeouts, skills relative-path detection, e2e concurrent-rotation 24-writer) — every one passes in isolation and on re-run; no single test repeats. Pattern says resource contention under bun's parallelism (timeouts sized for idle machines), not product defects. Chore: audit suite timeouts/parallelism budget rather than chasing individual tests.
